newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Dec electricity demand rises 1.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Dec electricity demand rises 1.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Demand for electricity supplied by nine Japanese power utilities rose 1.6 percent in December from a year earlier to 62.3 billion kilowatt hours (kWh), the Federation of Electric Power Companies said on Friday.

Electricity consumption by large-lot industrial users increased by 2.5 percent to 21.5 billion kWh, marking the fourth consecutive month it has risen on a year-on-year basis, a preliminary report by the federation showed.
The expansion was largely due to brisk consumption among paper-pulp companies, and firm demand from other industries, including steel, electric machinery and transportation machinery companies.
Electricity used for lighting households and offices declined by 0.4 percent from the previous year to 18.59 billion kWh.
